Chapter 359: Chapter 15 The ‘Uncrowned King’ of Tianqing World (Please Subscribe)

In the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s blood surged with fury, almost driving him mad on the spot.

The subordinates he trusted, the revered elders and masters, his sworn brothers, and the sweetheart he cherished.

All of them had betrayed him at this moment?

The Tianqing Alliance Leader was no fool. From the moment everyone surrounded him, an incredibly unbelievable thought sprang to his mind.

That these people had all betrayed him and turned to the Demigod Progeny.

...

But how could that be possible?

Not to mention what did the Demigod Progeny offer to buy over the subordinates he had nurtured over so many years.

The critical question was when did this happen?

He still had no idea about it until now?

A chill ran through the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s heart as he looked at the numerous powerful beings surrounding him not far away.

Just moments ago, they had still been respectful towards him, but now they were utterly cold, showing no sign of remorse on their faces.

“Do you all really know what you’re doing?”

Unable to accept this, the Tianqing Alliance Leader spoke in a low voice.

He wanted to ask why they sided with the Demigod Progeny?

Following him and enjoying the worship of countless beings in the Tianqing World, wasn’t that far better than siding with an Evil God?

The Tianqing Alliance Leader particularly fixed his gaze on Ayan.

This was his beloved, who, after repelling the Foreign Evil God, could stand atop all beings in the Tianqing World alongside the Tianqing Alliance Leader as he ruled.

Others might have a slight possibility of betraying him, but why would Ayan betray him?

Full of expectation, the Tianqing Alliance Leader looked towards Ayan, but what he received in return was only her cold gaze.

“Who are you, exactly?”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader did not attempt to break out of the encirclement.

Given the current situation where all his subordinates had betrayed him, and the instigator of it all, Lin Yuan, had yet to make a move,

The Tianqing Alliance Leader knew the chances of breaking out alone were slim.

If they dared to confront him directly, they must have made meticulous preparations.

So—

What the Tianqing Alliance Leader needed to do now

Was to buy time.

And then,

Summon back the World Sword.

Not long ago, on the Evil God Battlefield

The Tianqing Alliance Leader had left the World Sword outside the world.

To prevent any backlash from the Foreign Evil God.

Actually, this wasn’t a problem.

Even racking his brain, he hadn’t anticipated that

His biggest threat wouldn’t be the Ancestral Demon Tree from outside this world,

But Lin Yuan from within this world.

Regardless,

No matter what difficulties he faced

The Tianqing Alliance Leader believed that

As long as the World Sword was in hand, he could fear no circumstance.

For the World Sword was a World Weapon that had been nurtured by the Tianqing World for countless millennia.

The closer one was to the Tianqing World, the greater its power.

If it were to be activated within the world,

The Tianqing Alliance Leader was confident that even the Ancestral Demon Tree in its prime

Wouldn’t dare to confront him directly.

At that moment, he would take back everything that was his.

However,

As the Tianqing Alliance Leader bought time, Lin Yuan wasn’t unaware of it.

It had taken him great effort to find a moment when the Tianqing Alliance Leader was separated from the World Sword,

He certainly wouldn’t hold back.

As the Tianqing Alliance Leader turned his gaze towards him,

Lin Yuan immediately unleashed the Fiendgod Gaze.

This ability, derived from the Ancestral Demon Tree and similarly potent in the hands of the Demigod Progeny, how could it be any less powerful when executed by Lin Yuan?

Boom!!!

The terrifying soul fluctuations swept across the area.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader felt his thoughts shake and his consciousness slowly sinking.

“This is bad.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader was startled, forcing his mind to concentrate, biting his tongue, and resorting to using a forbidden technique to regain his clarity.

He immediately soared into the sky.

From that brief encounter,

The Tianqing Alliance Leader realized that staying to delay time was even more dangerous.

“The power of this move is hardly less than that of the Foreign Evil God. What kind of monster is this Demigod Progeny…”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s scalp exploded.

Doubts began to creep into his mind.

Had he really repelled that Foreign Evil God who possessed such a Demigod Progeny?

It made no sense.

Generally, the strength of the progenitor far surpasses that of its progeny.

The power of this Demigod Progeny he was facing suggested that its progenitor could easily obliterate the entire Tianqing World.

Yet the reality was the opposite.

The progenitor Evil God, during the destruction of the Evil God Battlefield, didn’t dare to show up.

With such a powerful Demigod at your disposal, why be so cowardly?

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s thoughts surged wildly as he raced out of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

He had already started to recall the World Sword, just a little longer, and he would—

The Tianqing Alliance Leader hadn’t finished thinking

When he saw the sky and earth reversing, the power of space swirling around, forming a cage.

“Just as expected.”

“Relying solely on the Demon Tree’s abilities, it’s still very difficult to completely detain you.”

Lin Yuan sighed lightly, his vines swaying as he manipulated the power of space, teleporting and pulling the Tianqing Alliance Leader back in front of him.

Even without the World Sword, the Tianqing Alliance Leader was still at the Seventh-Rank Peak.

Even for the Ancestral Demon Tree at its peak, killing the Tianqing Alliance Leader would take considerable effort, and there was a chance he could escape.

“What kind of technique is this?”

Unlike Lin Yuan’s sigh, the Tianqing Alliance Leader was thoroughly shocked.

He had clearly escaped some distance just now, so how had he ended up back here?
